title: About James Wolfe
body:
## The Author

James writes on grace, patience, and the ordinary shape of the Christian life. He lives and works in a quiet Midwestern town, publishes on Substack twice monthly, reads daily, and is always searching for sticks that might be swords.

## The Mission

This site exists to help weary Christians find comfort and confidence in Christ. James believes that he was placed in this world with the special gift to encourage weary Christians on the long road of obedience.

## The Intake

Currently reading the writings of the Puritans, as well as the Dragonkeeper Chronicles for fiction. Listening to Tim Keller sermons, and the Stories Are Soul Food & Truth Unites podcasts.
